project_summary: Solar plant monitoring platform connected to SCADA systems

components.name: OPC UA connector
components.description: Connector that subscribes to inverter and meter tags through OPC UA, handles reconnections and maps tags to a common asset model.

components.name: Historian and production reports
components.description: Storage of 1-minute production data, daily and monthly yield reports and comparison against expected irradiance.

components.name: Database migration from Oracle to PostgreSQL
components.description: Migration of the legacy Oracle historian schema and ten years of data to PostgreSQL with dual writes during the transition and zero downtime cut-over.
